*Ancillary services* are of utmost importance for a reliable operation of power systems, maybe even more so when increasing the penetration of renewable energy generation sources. These are to be procured and remunerated in a market environment.

This module covers:

- Ancillary services themselves
- Payment of capacity and energy
- How the various types of ancillary services are procured and remunerated
